CHAP USTUN:
• 'b) Polite Requests and Offers'.
14) 'Complete the dialogues below with sentences from the list.' Qiya ro'yxat: - Would you like anything written on it? - Certainly. How much would you like? - I think a chocolate one will be fine. - Two loaves, please. a) A: I'd like some bread, please. B: 1) ...... A: 2) ...... B: Here you are. b) A: I'd like to order a birthday cake, please. B: Of course. What type of cake would you like? A: 1) ...... B: 2) ...... A: Yes. 'Happy Birthday Elaine'.
• 'Reading'.
15) 'Read the letter and tick the objects that are in Mr Clarke's briefcase, then match the headings to the paragraphs.' RASM: A pasport (AQSh), B fotoapparat, C hujjatlar (papka), D qo'l soati, E durbin. XAT (pushti qog'oz, Para 1-4): 'Dear Sir/Madam, [Para 1] I believe I left a briefcase at the Bridge Hotel during my stay there from 6th to 9th June. I was staying in room 207. [Para 2] It is a rectangular black briefcase. It is quite large and is made of leather. My initials, ALC, are in gold letters on the handle. [Para 3] Inside, there are some important documents, a watch and a camera. [Para 4] If by any chance someone has handed my briefcase in to the hotel's lost property office, please contact me on (0171) 237 5429 before 8 pm. Yours faithfully, Andrew Lee Clarke'

O'NG USTUN:
PLAN (to'q sariq quti): description of lost item ......; reason for writing ......; description of contents ......; how to contact the owner ......
16) 'Read the dialogue and fill in the missing questions. Then, answer the questions which follow.' Qiya: - Did you have much money in the purse? - Was it that new one you bought? - How was your holiday in the Cotswolds? - It was quite old, wasn't it? DIALOG: A: Hi, Dora. 1) ...... B: Oh, great, thanks Barry. The countryside is so beautiful there. The only problem was that I think I left my handbag at the Lakeside Hotel, where I was staying. A: Oh no! 2) ...... B: No, it was an old one, but I really liked it. It was the small brown leather one. It's square and has got a long shoulder strap. You know the one. A: Oh yes, I remember. 3) ...... B: Yes, but the problem is that it had my purse in it and my address book. A: Oh dear. 4) ...... B: Well ... yes, over £80. A: I really think you should write to the hotel and see if they've found it.
  SAVOLLAR: 1 Where does Dora think she left her handbag? 2 What does her handbag look like? 3 What was inside the handbag? 4 How much money was in the purse? 5 What does Barry suggest?
• 'Writing (a formal letter inquiring about lost property)'.
17) 'Use the information from Ex. 16 and the plan in Ex. 15 to write Dora's letter to the hotel asking if they have found her handbag (80 - 120 words). Use the letter in Ex. 15 as a model.'

Bet raqami: pastda o'ngda '15'.
⚠ Orqa tomondan (16-bet, 'Days to Remember') sarlavha ko'chib ko'rinadi.

exercises.instructionEn: Complete the dialogues below with sentences from the list: Would you like anything written on it? / Certainly. How much would you like? / I think a chocolate one will be fine. / Two loaves, please.
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi dialoglarni ro'yxatdagi gaplar bilan to'ldiring: Would you like anything written on it? / Certainly. How much would you like? / I think a chocolate one will be fine. / Two loaves, please.
exercises.explanationUz:
DO'KONDA - MULOYIM SO'ROV va
  TAKLIF.

  MIJOZ: I'd like ... = ... xohlardim
    (I want dan MULOYIMROQ)
  SOTUVChI: Would you like ...? =
    ... xohlaysizmi?
    Certainly. = Albatta.
    Here you are. = Marhamat.


⚠ 'HOW MUCH WOULD YOU LIKE?':

  = Qancha xohlaysiz? (miqdor).
  Javob: 'Two loaves, please.'


⚠ 'A LOAF' → 'LOAVES':

  = bir buxanka non. Ko'plik:
  loaf → loaVES (f → ves).


⚠ 'A CHOCOLATE ONE':

  'one' = cake (takrorlamaslik).


⚠ 'ANYTHING WRITTEN ON IT':

  = ustiga biror narsa yozilsinmi?
  (tortga yozuv). Majhul: 'written'.


⚠ 'TO ORDER':

  = buyurtma bermoq.

lines.speaker: B
lines.answer: Certainly. How much would you like?
lines.whyUz: ⚠ Sotuvchi miqdorni so'raydi → keyingi javob 'Two loaves'.

lines.speaker: b A
lines.en: I'd like to order a birthday cake, please.
lines.uz: Tug'ilgan kun tortiga buyurtma bermoqchi edim, iltimos.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Of course. What type of cake would you like?

lines.speaker: A
lines.answer: I think a chocolate one will be fine.

lines.speaker: B
lines.answer: Would you like anything written on it?
lines.whyUz: ⚠ Keyingi javob 'Happy Birthday Elaine' (yozuv) → yozuv so'raladi.

exercises.instructionEn: Dear Sir/Madam, I believe I left a briefcase at the Bridge Hotel ... Yours faithfully, Andrew Lee Clarke
exercises.instructionUz: Hurmatli janob/xonim, Men portfelimni Bridge mehmonxonasida qoldirgan bo'lsam kerak ... Sodiqlik bilan, Endryu Li Klark
exercises.explanationUz:
RASMIY XAT - YO'QOLGAN BUYUM
  HAQIDA SO'ROV.

TUZILISh (4 xatboshi):
  1 Yozish sababi (qayerda, qachon
    qoldirdi)
  2 Yo'qolgan buyum tavsifi
    (shakl, rang, o'lcham, material,
    belgi)
  3 Ichidagi narsalar
  4 Egasi bilan bog'lanish usuli


⚠ RASMIY XAT BELGILARI:

  Dear Sir/Madam, - ism NOMA'LUM
  → Yours faithfully, + TO'LIQ ISM
  (7-betdagi 16c mashqni eslang!)
  Qisqartma YO'Q: 'I believe', 'It
  is' ('I'm' EMAS).


⚠ 'I BELIEVE I LEFT ...':

  = ... qoldirgan bo'lsam kerak
  (muloyim, ishonch bilan emas).


⚠ 'DURING MY STAY':

  = u yerda turgan paytimda.
  'a stay' = turish (ot).


⚠ 'MADE OF LEATHER':

  = charmdan yasalgan. 'made OF' +
  material.


⚠ 'INITIALS':

  = ism-familiya bosh harflari.
  ALC = Andrew Lee Clarke.


⚠ 'IF BY ANY CHANCE':

  = agar tasodifan.


⚠ 'TO HAND IN':

  = topshirmoq (topilgan narsani).
  'lost property office' = topilgan
  buyumlar bo'limi.


⚠ 'CONTACT ME ON (raqam)':

  = ... raqamga qo'ng'iroq qiling.
  Brit. 'on' + telefon raqami.
  (0171) - Londonning eski kodi.

points.en: I believe I left a briefcase at the Bridge Hotel during my stay there from 6th to 9th June. I was staying in room 207.
points.uz: Men 6-9-iyun kunlari Bridge mehmonxonasida turgan paytimda portfelimni u yerda qoldirgan bo'lsam kerak. Men 207-xonada turgan edim.
points.noteUz:
⚠ PARA 1 - yozish sababi (reason for writing).
⚠ 'during my stay' = turgan paytimda.

points.en: It is a rectangular black briefcase. It is quite large and is made of leather. My initials, ALC, are in gold letters on the handle.
points.uz: Bu to'rtburchak qora portfel. U ancha katta va charmdan yasalgan. Bosh harflarim, ALC, dastasida oltin harflar bilan yozilgan.
points.noteUz:
⚠ PARA 2 - yo'qolgan buyum tavsifi (description of lost item).
⚠ Sifatlar: shakl + rang; 'made of leather'.

points.en: Inside, there are some important documents, a watch and a camera.
points.uz: Ichida muhim hujjatlar, qo'l soati va fotoapparat bor.
points.noteUz:
⚠ PARA 3 - ichidagi narsalar (description of contents).
⚠ Rasmda: C (hujjatlar), D (soat), B (fotoapparat) - belgilanadi; A (pasport), E (durbin) - YO'Q.

points.en: If by any chance someone has handed my briefcase in to the hotel's lost property office, please contact me on (0171) 237 5429 before 8 pm.
points.uz: Agar tasodifan kimdir portfelimni mehmonxonaning topilgan buyumlar bo'limiga topshirgan bo'lsa, iltimos, soat 20:00 gacha (0171) 237 5429 raqamiga qo'ng'iroq qiling.
points.noteUz:
⚠ PARA 4 - bog'lanish usuli (how to contact the owner).
⚠ 'hand in' = topshirmoq.
⚠ RASMIY yakun: 'Dear Sir/Madam' → 'Yours faithfully' + to'liq ism.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the letter and tick the objects that are in Mr Clarke's briefcase: A passport, B camera, C documents, D watch, E binoculars.
exercises.instructionUz: Xatni o'qing va janob Klarkning portfelidagi narsalarni belgilang: A pasport, B fotoapparat, C hujjatlar, D qo'l soati, E durbin.
exercises.explanationUz:
PORTFEL IChIDA (Para 3):
  'some important documents, a
   watch and a camera'

  ✓ C documents
  ✓ D watch
  ✓ B camera
  ✗ A passport - xatda YO'Q
  ✗ E binoculars - xatda YO'Q


⚠ 'BINOCULARS':

  = durbin. HAR DOIM KO'PLIK
  ('a pair of binoculars').

items.sentence: A - The passport is in the briefcase.
B - The camera is in the briefcase.
C - The documents are in the briefcase.
D - The watch is in the briefcase.
E - The binoculars are in the briefcase.

exercises.instructionEn: Match the headings to the paragraphs. PLAN: description of lost item, reason for writing, description of contents, how to contact the owner.
exercises.instructionUz: Sarlavhalarni xatboshilarga moslang. REJA: yo'qolgan buyum tavsifi, yozish sababi, ichidagi narsalar tavsifi, egasi bilan bog'lanish usuli.
exercises.explanationUz:
RASMIY XAT REJASI - 4 XATBOShI:

  Para 1 - reason for writing
    (yozish sababi)
  Para 2 - description of lost item
    (buyum tavsifi)
  Para 3 - description of contents
    (ichidagi narsalar)
  Para 4 - how to contact the owner
    (bog'lanish)

  ⚠ 17-MAShQDA ShU REJA KERAK.


⚠ 'CONTENTS':

  = ichidagi narsalar (mundarija
  ham!).

pairs.whyUz: Para 2: 'It is a rectangular black briefcase ... made of leather ...'
Para 1: 'I believe I left a briefcase at the Bridge Hotel ...'
Para 3: 'Inside, there are some important documents, a watch and a camera.'
Para 4: 'please contact me on (0171) 237 5429 before 8 pm.'

exercises.instructionEn: Read the dialogue and fill in the missing questions: Did you have much money in the purse? / Was it that new one you bought? / How was your holiday in the Cotswolds? / It was quite old, wasn't it?
exercises.instructionUz: Dialogni o'qing va tushib qolgan savollarni qo'ying: Did you have much money in the purse? / Was it that new one you bought? / How was your holiday in the Cotswolds? / It was quite old, wasn't it?
exercises.explanationUz:
DORA va BARRY - YO'QOLGAN SUMKA.

  ⚠ Har savol KEYINGI JAVOBGA
  qarab tanlanadi:
  1 'Oh, great, thanks' → 'How was
    your holiday ...?'
  2 'No, it was an old one' → 'Was
    it that new one you bought?'
  3 'Yes, but the problem is ...' →
    'It was quite old, wasn't it?'
  4 'yes, over £80' → 'Did you have
    much money in the purse?'


⚠ THE COTSWOLDS:

  = Kotsvolds - Angliyaning
  janubi-g'arbidagi go'zal tepalik
  hudud.


⚠ 'THE COUNTRYSIDE':

  = qishloq joy, tabiat.


⚠ 'A HANDBAG':

  = ayollar sumkasi.
  'A PURSE' = hamyon (ayollar).
  'A SHOULDER STRAP' = yelka
  tasmasi.


⚠ 'YOU KNOW THE ONE':

  = o'shani bilasan-ku.


⚠ 'WASN'T IT?':

  = shundaymi? - tasdiq so'rovi
  (question tag).


⚠ 'OVER £80':

  = 80 funtdan ortiq.


⚠ 'YOU SHOULD WRITE':

  = yozishing kerak - MASLAHAT.

lines.speaker: A
lines.answer: How was your holiday in the Cotswolds?
lines.uz: Salom, Dora. Kotsvoldsdagi ta'tiling qanday o'tdi?
lines.whyUz: ⚠ Javob 'Oh, great, thanks' → ta'til haqida savol.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Oh, great, thanks Barry. The countryside is so beautiful there. The only problem was that I think I left my handbag at the Lakeside Hotel, where I was staying.
lines.uz: O, zo'r, rahmat Barri. U yerda tabiat juda go'zal. Yagona muammo - sumkamni turgan joyim, Lakeside mehmonxonasida qoldirganman shekilli.
lines.whyUz: ⚠ Bo'shliq yo'q. Muammo: sumka mehmonxonada qolgan.

lines.speaker: A
lines.answer: Was it that new one you bought?
lines.uz: Voy! O'sha sotib olgan yangi sumkangmi?
lines.whyUz: ⚠ Javob 'No, it was an old one' → yangi sumka haqida savol.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: No, it was an old one, but I really liked it. It was the small brown leather one. It's square and has got a long shoulder strap. You know the one.
lines.uz: Yo'q, eskisi edi, lekin uni juda yaxshi ko'rardim. O'sha kichik jigarrang charm sumka. U kvadrat va uzun yelka tasmasi bor. O'shani bilasan-ku.
lines.whyUz: ⚠ Bo'shliq yo'q. Sumka TAVSIFI (17-mashq uchun kerak).

lines.speaker: A
lines.answer: It was quite old, wasn't it?
lines.uz: Ha, eslayman. U ancha eski edi, shundaymi?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Yes, but the problem is that it had my purse in it and my address book.
lines.uz: Ha, lekin muammo shundaki, ichida hamyonim va manzil daftarim bor edi.

lines.speaker: A
lines.answer: Did you have much money in the purse?

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: I really think you should write to the hotel and see if they've found it.
lines.uz: Menimcha, mehmonxonaga yozib, topganmi-yo'qmi bilishing kerak.
lines.whyUz: ⚠ Bo'shliq yo'q. Barrining TAKLIFI: mehmonxonaga yozish.

exercises.explanationUz:
DIALOGGA QARAB JAVOB.

  ⚠ Javoblar 17-mashqdagi xat
  uchun MATERIAL:
  1 qayerda - Lakeside Hotel
  2 tavsif - small, brown, leather,
    square, long shoulder strap
  3 ichida - purse, address book
  4 pul - over £80
  5 taklif - write to the hotel

exercises.instructionEn: Use the information from Ex. 16 and the plan in Ex. 15 to write Dora's letter to the hotel asking if they have found her handbag (80 - 120 words). Use the letter in Ex. 15 as a model.
exercises.instructionUz: 16-mashqdagi ma'lumot va 15-mashqdagi rejadan foydalanib, Doraning mehmonxonaga sumkasini topganmi-yo'qmi deb so'rab yozgan xatini yozing (80-120 so'z). 15-mashqdagi xatdan namuna sifatida foydalaning.
exercises.explanationUz:
RASMIY XAT - DORANING SUMKASI.

REJA (15-mashq):
  Dear Sir/Madam,
  1 Yozish sababi: Lakeside Hotel,
    qachon, qaysi xona
  2 Buyum tavsifi: small, brown,
    leather, square, long shoulder
    strap
  3 Ichida: purse (over £80),
    address book
  4 Bog'lanish: telefon raqami
  Yours faithfully, + to'liq ism


⚠ RASMIY USLUB:

  Qisqartma YO'Q: 'I am', 'It is'.
  'I believe I left ...'
  'If by any chance ...'
  'please contact me on ...'


⚠ 'INQUIRING ABOUT':

  = ... haqida so'rab.
  'to inquire' = so'ramoq (rasmiy).


⚠ 80-120 SO'Z.

modelAnswers:
Dear Sir/Madam,

I believe I left a handbag at the Lakeside Hotel during my stay there last week. I was staying in room 112.

It is a small square brown handbag. It is quite old and is made of leather. It has got a long shoulder strap.

Inside, there is my purse with over £80 in it and my address book.

If by any chance someone has handed my handbag in to the hotel's lost property office, please contact me on (0181) 445 6721 before 9 pm.

Yours faithfully,
Dora Wilson
modelAnswersUz:
Hurmatli janob/xonim,

Men o'tgan hafta Lakeside mehmonxonasida turgan paytimda sumkamni u yerda qoldirgan bo'lsam kerak. Men 112-xonada turgan edim.

Bu kichik kvadrat jigarrang sumka. U ancha eski va charmdan yasalgan. Uzun yelka tasmasi bor.

Ichida 80 funtdan ortiq puli bor hamyonim va manzil daftarim bor.

Agar tasodifan kimdir sumkamni mehmonxonaning topilgan buyumlar bo'limiga topshirgan bo'lsa, iltimos, soat 21:00 gacha (0181) 445 6721 raqamiga qo'ng'iroq qiling.

Sodiqlik bilan,
Dora Uilson
